provenance.source: Vendored verbatim from openstudio-standards NECB2020/data/*.json (tables) and NECB2011/data/curves.json (performance curves); values correspond to NECB 2020 Table 5.2.12.1 minimum performance requirements
provenance.note: Capacity match rule (ported from legacy model_find_object): row matches when minimum_capacity < capacity <= maximum_capacity, retried at 0.99x capacity on boundary misses; criteria keys absent from a row act as wildcards. VERIFIED against the printed NECB 2020 tables via MCP 2026-08-02 (D-59): unitary_acs = Table 5.2.12.1.-A exact; PTAC rows = Table -G exact (formula coefficient 0.3058/kBtu-h = printed 1.0435/kW unit-converted); heat_pumps >= 19 kW = Table -A exact, < 19 kW = Table -B SPVAC EER 11 (documented interpretation); heat_pumps_heating = Table -A exact; boilers = Table -N exact; furnaces = Table -O exact (strict-side row choices documented); chillers = Table -K PATH B full-load COPc exact. The heat_rejection family is VESTIGIAL for the reference path - never read by apply_efficiencies; the reference tower fan is set by apply_tower_rules from Table 5.2.12.2 plus the 8.4.4.11.(2)-(3) cell rules (D-26). IEER/IPLV/SCOP columns are not modeled: EnergyPlus carries full-load COP plus the vendored NECB reference part-load curves.

curves.name: DXCOOL-NECB2011-REF-COOLEIRFFLOW
curves.notes: Not supplied by NECB 2011 but required for EnergyPlus.  Used default curve coefficients from OpenStudio 2.8.1 DX Single Speed Cooling Coil.

curves.name: DXCOOL-NECB2011-REF-COOLEIRFT
curves.notes: Regenerated 2026-07-22 from NECB 2020 8.4.5.4.(7) == NECB 2025 8.4.6.4.(7) (coefficient sets verified identical across editions) via the exact degF->degC variable substitution; self-checks to ~1.0 at the 67F wb / 95F odb rating point. Replaces the legacy NECB 2011-derived surface whose twb terms deviated up to 1.95% off-rating (see scripts/necb_8_4_6_curve_probe.rb).

curves.name: DXCOOL-NECB2011-REF-COOLPLFFPLR
curves.notes: Refit 2026-07-22: least-squares cubic of PLF(PLR) = PLR / EIR_FPLR(PLR) over PLR 0.25-1.0, from the NECB 2020 8.4.5.4.(5) == 2025 8.4.6.4.(5) EIR_FPLR cubic (identical across editions). Output clamped to [0.7, 1.0] (PLF > 1 is nonphysical; E+ guidance floor 0.7). A cubic cannot represent the rational target exactly: max implied-EIR deviation ~2.0% (the structural floor; was 3.70% with the legacy 0.7-floored refit). See scripts/necb_8_4_6_curve_probe.rb.
